snippet.title: Scruffy Minus: SAGE 2025 Demo Trailer!
snippet.description:
Scruffy Minus has a brand new demo for SAGE 2025! The game has been remade since the last demo, featuring new high-octane, bouncy, and freaky gameplay! There aren't quite as many levels as last year, but this year's demo features remade levels, and local multiplayer racing action, and the Battle Suit Arena!

Download the game at

https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/super-freaks-side-story-scruffy-minus-the-rise-of-the-anti-freaks-sage-2025-demo.2755
/

https://riegelsoft.itch.io/scruffy-minus
